span: NVIDIA invested $5B into Intel
rule: 现行：§5.3'已知事实的重述'（第 1 版不进本周笔记；抽取看不到库 D211，评估怎么算待拍第 6 条；参考答案第 2 版按可选记）；提议：文中看不出是旧事，按待拍第 6 条不算重述，§6.3 第 1 条 (d) 已完成的投资对 NVIDIA 规模不大 → 辅助

span: opted for Intel Xeon 6 as the host CPU in their DGX Rubin NVL8 AI systems
rule: 现行：§5.3'已知事实的重述'（第 1 版不进本周笔记；抽取看不到库 D211，评估怎么算待拍第 6 条；参考答案第 2 版按可选记）；提议 §6.3 第 3 步：是在研公司那一代产品的配置、确定状态，但只是一款 DGX 系统的主机 CPU，对公司是小事 → 辅助

span: the CPU:GPU ratio for inference is beginning to shift from 1-to-8 to 1:1
rule: 现行 §6.1 辅助（支持或反驳 GPU 在推理支出里的份额判断）；提议 §6.3 第 1 条 (c)：别家公司的说法，碰到 NVIDIA 支出构成但没有期间 → 辅助

span: We will probably double our size over the coming years
rule: 现行 §6.1 辅助（供应商说 AI 需求带动光纤需求，支持需求判断）；提议 §6.3 第 1 条 (c) 别家公司自己的经营预测是间接指标，且没有期间 → 辅助

span: big spending announcements by Samsung and SK Hynix
rule: 现行 §6.1 辅助（关键投入存储的供给动作，没有数）；提议 §6.3 第 3 步：碰到关键投入，'宣布了'是确定状态，但没有量、没有内容，信息量低 → 辅助（见 notes）

span: $627 billion in remaining commercial performance obligations
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：客户公布的数字（第 1 版例 Google Cloud 积压，Alex 判 11）；§6.1 辅助：支持需求判断；§6.3 辅助例：客户公布的订单积压

span: Yet even those chips fail to match the quality of the H200 because they have slower memory
rule: §5.3 产品细节一行的边界：对手产品和本公司产品比的说法要留（Alex 判 4，辅助）；§5.1 第 2 类（对手有名字、有日期的动作）

span: In March, it introduced a new chip, the 950PR, and is preparing to launch another later this year.
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：对手的产品发布和计划（第二轮盲读后补，X032）

span: This resistance has led to the delay or cancellation of at least 75 projects in just the first quarter of 2026
rule: §5.2 不完整、没出处也是证据，层级另记；§6.1 辅助：支持或反驳 AI 建设需求（电力、选址约束）的判断；§6.3 (c)：行业计数是间接指标 → 辅助

span: Taiwan says it has secured supplies through the end of the year, but uncertainty looms afterward
rule: §5.1 第 3 类；§6.1 辅助：支持或反驳关键投入（台湾晶圆厂的能源）供给的判断；§6.3 (c)：离 NVIDIA 的关键投入隔一层，间接 → 辅助

span: Samsung and SK Hynix, the two local giants that produce most of Nvidia’s memory chips, are pursuing massive expansions to meet surging chip demand
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：内存供应商扩产（D240）（第二轮盲读后补，X043）

span: The platform is now free for development, production, and redistribution, with no NVIDIA AI Enterprise subscription required
rule: §5.1 第 1 类原例（Alex 判 8，Omniverse）；§6.1 辅助（D215 第 8 题 B）；§6.3 辅助例：公司取消软件订阅费

span: Cadence, Schneider Electric, Siemens, Vertiv, Eaton, Jacobs, and others contributing SimReady assets and integrating their design tools
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：具名伙伴的集成（D240）

span: Nvidia will act as a financial backstop for neocloud GPU deployments, agreeing to rent back unused GPUs at a fixed rate in exchange for a share of cloud revenue generated on that capacity
rule: §6.1 核心：直接改变融资或信用风险的判断（例：Ohio 1050 亿担保）；§6.3 核心例：公司宣布为云客户产能兜底的新计划（确定状态，没给金额）

span: Valve has confirmed that it has a growing team closely working with Team Green to bring official support for Nvidia GPUs
rule: §5.3 第 1 行边界：伙伴、客户采用或集成的动作不是产品细节（§5.1 第 2 类）；§5.2 / D240 有名字没金额也留。§6.1 辅助：支持游戏平台覆盖的判断，不直接改变收入。§6.3 第 3 步：没碰到关键判断（对 NVIDIA 是小事）→ 辅助

span: NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB has now landed back on retail shelves
rule: §5.1 第 1 类：公司自己的决定；§6.1 辅助：支持关键投入（内存）短缺压到游戏产品的判断，对 NVIDIA 规模不是核心；§6.3 第 3 步：游戏低端卡的供货安排对公司是小事 → 辅助

span: neither Nvidia or the Neoclouds have any intention of using the backstop
rule: §6.1 辅助「支持或反驳上述判断」(likelihood the obligation turns into cash out)

span: Lenders look to Nvidia’s backstop and its AA/Aa2 investment grade credit rating and are satisfied to lend matching the length of the backstop.
rule: §6.1 辅助 (NVIDIA credit standing carries the financing)

span: Nvidia’s backstop program is only getting started, and we see announcements coming faster every quarter. Many Neoclouds are already deep in negotiations with Nvidia
rule: §6.1 辅助 (no amount); §6.3 第3步「确定状态」: 'have backstops' is a stated state → 核心; see notes；D243 第 1 条：在谈但没有量，不是确定状态，辅助

span: For its third fiscal quarter of 2026, Micron reported revenue of $41.46 billion.
rule: §5.1 第2类 供应商公布的数字; §6.3(c) 例「内存厂公布的季度收入和利润率」→ 辅助

span: Apple said it can no longer absorb the surge in memory and storage costs and announced price increases for some Macs and iPads, citing higher memory costs.
rule: §5.1 第2类 有名字的动作, 碰到关键投入（内存）价格; §6.3(c) 间接指标 → 辅助

span: The gap could give competitors like AMD's MI500X or Google's TPUv8i Broadfly room to move in.
rule: §5.1 第3类 带理由的具体判断; §6.1 辅助 (competition)

span: Klein noted that Hon Hai management forecasted a continued acceleration in AI demand
rule: §5.1 第2类 供应商有名字的表态, 没数也留 (D240); §6.3 no quantity → 辅助

span: Governor Spencer Cox responded with an executive order putting guardrails on data center development
rule: §5.1 第4类 政策的决定或步骤; §5.3 边界「官员宣布的政策步骤要留」; §6.3(d) one state, small → 辅助

span: Nvidia's 2026 Rubin GPUs, which reuse the current Oberon rack, aren't part of the reported delay.
rule: §5.4 条件 (scope of the claim); §6.1 辅助

span: Leading wearable and XR device makers including Haptikos, Manus, Noitom, OpenGraph Labs, PICO, Sensing, HTC Vive, Wuji, and Xsens offer devices with native support for NVIDIA Isaac Teleop
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：具名厂商集成（D240）（第二轮盲读后补，X095）

span: there are signals that NVIDIA is going ahead with the lineup instead of canceling it
rule: 产品进度（Alex 判 10：NVL72x2 取消归产品进度）；§5.2 传闻也是证据；§6.1 辅助（游戏换代，不是关键产品）；§6.3 第 3 步：没有确定状态 → 辅助

span: tight market conditions could last until 2028
rule: §5.1 第 3 类，例子'内存厂说…短缺…持续到 2030'；§6.1 核心，例子'内存短缺到 2030'（D215 第 3 题 A）；§6.3 (c) 别家直接说出关键投入的状况（短缺到哪年）按关键判断算，带期间的预测 → 核心

span: new capacity for many in this industry won't be online until 2027 or later, creating a low supply of inventory for at least the next year and a half
rule: §5.1 第 3 类：作者对关键投入供给的带期间预测

span: The committee has proposed legislation that would phase out Chinese-made lidar technology in the United States
rule: §5.1 第 4 类：政策步骤；§6.1 辅助，例子'政策表态'（D215 第 6 题 B）；§6.3 第 3 步：没碰到关键判断 → 辅助

span: McKinsey & Company estimates the market potential for autonomous driving will be roughly $300 billion to $400 billion by 2035.
rule: §5.1 第 3 类：具名一方的估计；§5.2 远期也是证据；§6.1 辅助；§6.3 第 3 步：不是关键判断（汽车是小业务）→ 辅助

span: SambaNova is now valued at $11 billion thanks to the financing, which was led by General Atlantic
rule: §5.1 第 2 类 竞争者有规模的动作；§6.1 辅助；§6.3 (c) 别家公司自己的数字是间接指标 → 辅助

span: JPMorgan has selected SambaNova to be the inference provider for the bank
rule: §5.1 第 2 类（'一家银行选用竞争对手的系统'）；§6.3 辅助例：一家银行选用对手系统（没写金额）

span: Rental prices for older GPU models have been climbing
rule: §5.1 第 3 类；§6.1 辅助；§6.3：没有量也没有期间 → 辅助

span: AI startup Perplexity has also chosen to use Nvidia’s new CPUs for AI agent tasks.
rule: §5.1 第 2 类 客户有名字的动作（D240）；§6.3 辅助例：客户采用但没写金额

span: LangChain tuned its Deep Agents harness for NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
rule: §5.1 第 2 类 伙伴集成本公司模型（D240：有名字，没金额也留）；§6.3 辅助例：伙伴把公司模型集成进系统（没写金额）

span: LangChain developers can access Nemotron 3 Ultra on Baseten , Crusoe Cloud , DeepInfra, Fireworks , Nebius and Together AI platforms
rule: §5.1 第 2 类：具名平台提供公司的模型（D240）
